findings.claim: Generic default-release public route exists; dynamic VN/starter/node/employee/battle authority must be preserved; API002 read source contains no nonzero advance.
Default release drops final active battle provenance; authoring observation must be captured before active_battle removal or retained separately under bounded explicit lifetime.
Cast+site+target+time is not unique for repeats; existing damage/proc semantic identity must be preserved, additional observation-only application qualification is required where absent.
R02 StartNewGame generation atomicity is insufficient for R03 actual battle preparation; build candidate CoreApplication aggregate and swap only after real preparation.
Synchronous same-time bucket and until-time loop have no general execution budget/cancel checks; host step/clock caps alone cannot safely interrupt one call.
Output allocation/serialization failure after core commit must not masquerade as a rejected operation; preserve trace on/off gameplay invariance and explicit incomplete history.
Numeric authoring caps, actual fuel coverage, final output retention cost and generation reclamation require focused implementation measurements; no new measured bound or R23 completion claim.
